name: Data Analyzer: Health check works without a key even when keys are configured
objective: Shows the health check stays public.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Request the health check with no key.
steps.expected: HTTP 200; status is 'healthy' or 'degraded'; services is present.

name: Data Analyzer: Front page works without a key
objective: Shows the front page stays public.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.expected: HTTP 200; reply contains message and version.

name: Data Analyzer: Data check without a key is refused with 401 and an 'ApiKey' challenge
objective: Shows, through a real web request, that a missing key is refused before any processing and the reply names the credential type.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Post a tiny CSV to the analyze endpoint with no key header.
steps.expected: HTTP 401; WWW-Authenticate header equals 'ApiKey'; the body has a detail or error entry.

name: Data Analyzer: Data check with a wrong key is refused with 403
objective: Shows a wrong key gives a different status (403) from a missing key (401).
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Post a tiny CSV with the key 'definitely-wrong-key'.
steps.expected: HTTP 403; the body has a detail or error entry.

name: Data Analyzer: Data check with the correct key is accepted and produces a report
objective: Shows the correct key is let through and the analysis runs.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Post a tiny CSV with the correct key.
steps.expected: HTTP 200; the reply contains summary, issues or quality_checks.

name: Data Analyzer: Dictionary fetch also requires the key (401 without, 403 with wrong)
objective: Shows key protection applies to a second address too, not only the data check.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Request the same address with a wrong key.

name: Data Analyzer: API key is not written to the log (weak check)
objective: Shows the key is not logged when the key check runs. Likely nothing is logged at all, so the check may pass without testing much.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Run the key check with the correct key and read the captured log records.
steps.expected: No captured log record contains the key text.

name: Data Analyzer: Admin password is not written to the log (weak check)
objective: As above for the administrator password.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Run the admin check with the correct password and read the captured log records.
steps.expected: No captured log record contains the password.

name: Data Analyzer: Refusal text does not contain the typed key, the real key or the setting name
objective: Shows error messages do not leak secrets.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.expected: The refusal message contains neither 'wrong-key', the real key, nor 'DATA_ANALYZER_API_KEY'.

name: Data Analyzer: Configured key and admin password are loaded by the server
objective: Shows the server picks up the settings it was given.
precondition: Server application reloaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Read the key and admin password held by the server.
steps.expected: Both are present and equal the configured values.

name: Data Analyzer: With no settings, the server holds no key and no admin password
objective: Shows authentication is off when nothing is configured.
precondition: Server application reloaded with all environment settings cleared and the local settings file ignored.

steps.action: Read the key and admin password held by the server.

name: Data Analyzer: With no key configured, a data check without a key succeeds
objective: Shows the designed permissive behaviour through a real web request.
precondition: Server application reloaded with all environment settings cleared and the local settings file ignored.

steps.action: Post a tiny CSV to the analyze endpoint with no key header.
steps.expected: HTTP 200; the reply contains summary, issues or quality_checks.
